correctness.rationale: For the standard sunlet L_n=C_n⊙K1, n≥3, connectivity forces each initially blue leaf to have its blue cycle support. The blue cycle vertices form one consecutive path unless all cycle vertices are selected, because any separated blocks disconnect the blue induced subgraph. The omitted cycle block has length t≥1. For t=1 the remaining vertex is forced iff at least one neighbouring boundary leaf is initially selected. For t=2 (n≥4), both boundary leaves must be initially selected to force both inner omitted cycle vertices before their leaves. For t≥3, after potential first boundary forces every newly blue end has two white neighbours (its pendant and next omitted cycle vertex), so progress stalls. These cases are disjoint and exhaust all connected forcing sets; the all-n polynomial is x^n(1+x)^n+n x^(n-1)((1+x)^2-1)(1+x)^(n-3)+n x^n(1+x)^(n-4) for n≥4, with the final term omitted at n=3. The minimal size is n; the number of minimum sets is 7 at n3 and 3n+1 for n≥4; totals are 17 and 2^(n-4)(7n+16). Independent graph-based connectivity/BFS and simultaneous colour-change simulation exhaustively checked every labelled vertex subset of L_n for 3≤n≤7 against all polynomial coefficients. Finite tests support, but do not establish, the uniform structural argument.

originality.rationale: Brimkov (2016) treats unicyclic connected forcing MINIMUM sizes, not all-size sunlet enumeration. Brimkov–Davila–Schuerger (2025) introduces z_c(G;i), provides exact general results for trees, minimum sets and corona claims requiring a nontrivial/isolate-free attached H; the 25-page full preprint contains no sunlet and excludes H=K1 from its corona theorems. The scalar sunlet identity Zc=n is already known and not claimed new. The natural all-size sunlet polynomial and boundary-leaf classification are the retained work. A plausible 2026 Rice thesis with qualitative statements was not inspected in full; this is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Full relevant Rice 2026 dissertation was not accessible; it could contain an equivalent cardinality polynomial.
Forcing interpretation assumes simultaneous standard zero forcing, not chronology counting; excludes partial/multiple-leaf sunlets.

value.rationale: Counting every connected sensor/forcing seed set at each cardinality, not only the minimum number, is a natural refinement of connected zero forcing. The explicit three-class characterization and full generating polynomial for the baseline unicyclic family give directly usable exact counts and coverage of all sizes, not a renamed minimum-size deduction.
